notes.title: Christmas Update
notes.content:
Howdy fellow Cowboys and Cowgirls, Today we have heard news that during the entirety of December, we are going to be hit with snow and new hostiles are being discovered!

As of right now we are aware of 3 new hostiles...
[list]
[*] Snowmen
[*] Reindeers
[*] Elves
[/list]

Though there are rumours that there is yet another enemy. But we are unsure. But one thing is for certain, it is snowy... Really snowy... So be careful. I wish you the best!
